pli-tv-kd1:56.1.5: The training rule of refraining from killing living creatures,
pli-tv-kd1:56.1.6: The training rule of refraining from taking what has not been given,
pli-tv-kd1:56.1.7: The training rule of refraining from unchastity,
pli-tv-kd1:56.1.8: The training rule of refraining from false speech,
pli-tv-kd1:56.1.9: The training rule of refraining from liquor, wines, or intoxicants which cause heedlessness.
pli-tv-kd1:56.1.10: The training rule of refraining from eating at the wrong time,
pli-tv-kd1:56.1.11: The training rule of refraining from dances, songs, music, and watching shows,
pli-tv-kd1:56.1.12: The training rule of refraining from adorning or ornamenting (oneself) by wearing garlands, scents, or ointments,
pli-tv-kd1:56.1.13: The training rule of refraining from lofty or grand beds,
pli-tv-kd1:56.1.14: The training rule of refraining from accepting gold or money.
